name: session_start
description: Briefing at the start of a session: last session, open failures, recent lessons, Brain health.

name: session_end
description: Save what was built; extract lessons from the summary and the git log.

name: smart_recall
description: Search past lessons and context with one line about the task (BM25, semantic and causal graph).

name: recall_best_solution
description: Return the known fix for a topic, with its success and failure history.

name: learn_from_attempts
description: Store a structured lesson after a fix, deploy or discovery.

name: remember_context
description: Keep architecture findings, decisions and file summaries for later sessions.

name: recall_context
description: Retrieve previously saved context by key.

name: forget_context
description: Delete one or more saved context entries.

name: list_remembered
description: List all saved context entries for this project.

name: causal_trace
description: Root-cause analysis through the causal knowledge graph, starting from an error message.

name: brain_predict
description: Predict likely failures before a risky step such as a deploy or migration.

name: semantic_search
description: Find saved entries that are semantically similar to a natural-language query (read-only).

name: brain_search
description: Full-text search over all Brain data: lessons, context, sessions, graph nodes, roadmap.

name: autopilot
description: Write a CLAUDE.md / copilot-instructions.md that makes the agent use the Brain (overwrites an existing file at the target path).

name: brain_doctor
description: Check the health of the Brain and give recommendations.

name: brain_from_git
description: Fill people, files and lessons from git history, incrementally.

name: index_project
description: Index local source files so semantic_search can find them.

name: team_recall
description: Recall lessons from a shared team Brain, showing who learned what.

name: team_learn
description: Store a lesson in a shared team Brain with an author name.

name: cache_get
description: Get a value from a cache instance by key.

name: cache_set
description: Set a key-value pair in a cache instance (overwrites an existing value).

name: roadmap_add
description: Add an item to the persistent project roadmap.

name: roadmap_list
description: List roadmap items, optionally filtered by status, priority, tag or milestone.

name: roadmap_next
description: Get the most important next actionable roadmap item.

name: roadmap_update
description: Update status, priority or details of a roadmap item.

name: session_handoff
description: Save a detailed handoff for the next chat window or session.

name: cachly_tool
description: Dispatcher: run any of the other 98 cachly tools by name (describe:true returns the schema first).
